# HywMill: prebuilt jar

`hywmill-m3.jar` is the frozen M3 build (garrisons, M2 doctrine, M1.1 bridge), built from this branch.

It contains only HywMill's own classes. Nothing from Millénaire, HYW or Epic Knights is bundled.

## Install

Put these jars in your NeoForge 21.1.226 (Minecraft 1.21.1) `mods/` folder:

* `hywmill-m3.jar` (this file)
* Millénaire 9.0.2
* Hundred Years War 0.7.1r-fix1
